t1.C10: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C11: skip: empty in every row (print-layout spacer column)
t1.C12: kpi:ytd — period label (roman month / I-X year to date)

t2.SHEET: skip: the sheet's print title (one sheet per table)

t3.RELEASE_NO: skip: one edition per table (history_releases 1); the edition number comes from the releases input

t3.ROW: key: row order — labels are found by text, not by row number

t3.C03: skip: day visits by land in the month

t3.C11: skip: day visits, year to date
t3.C12: skip: tourists by land, year to date
